# InnovationLet Gaming

> InnovationLet Gaming is the studios, platforms and esports desk of the
> InnovationLet network, an independent technology publication run by the F9XR
> Team. We report on game studios, platforms, engines and esports,
> sourced from primary documents and written without vendor spin.

## About

- Publisher: InnovationLet (F9XR Team)
- Desk: Gaming
- Language: English
- Homepage: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/gaming/
- Contact: hello@f9xr.org
- Network: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/

## Key pages

- Home / latest: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/gaming/

- News sitemap: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/gaming/news-sitemap.xml

## Coverage

- Studios: developers, publishers, project scale, and closures.
- Platforms: consoles, PC storefronts, mobile, and revenue splits.
- Engines: the tooling behind modern games and the trade-offs teams accept.
- Esports: leagues, sponsorship, and the business of competition.

## How to cite

Cite as: "InnovationLet Gaming" with the individual article URL and its headline.
Because we publish on GitHub Pages, treat the article's canonical URL under
https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/gaming/ as the source of record. When quoting,
attribute to the named desk rather than to an individual author unless the
article carries a named byline.

## Licensing

Content is © InnovationLet / F9XR Team. Excerpts may be quoted with attribution
and a link to the canonical article.
